0, 1 or 2 resistant copies } pyramid <- function(strategy, n_f2, n_f3, link_cM, marker_cM, cost_per_plant, seed) {   pos <- list(chr1 = c(mA = -marker_cM, A = 0, B = link_cM, mB = link_cM + marker_cM),               chr2 = c(mC = -marker_cM, C = 0))   f1 <- list(chr1 = list(h1 = rbind(c(mA = 1, A = 1, B = 0, mB = 0)), h2 = rbind(c(mA = 0, A = 0, B = 1, mB = 1))),              chr2 = list(h1 = rbind(c(mC = 0, C = 0)), h2 = rbind(c(mC = 1, C = 1))))   f2 <- self_plants(f1, n_f2, pos)   hom_all <- function(p, loci) Reduce(`&`, lapply(loci, function(l) genotype(p, l) == 2))   genotyped <- n_f2   if (strategy == "F2") {     chosen <- hom_all(f2, c("mA", "mB", "mC"))     final <- f2   } else {     keep <- which(hom_all(f2, c("mA", "mC")) & genotype(f2, "mB") >= 1)     if (!length(keep)) {       return(list(success = 0, cost = genotyped * cost_per_plant, generations = 2, plants = genotyped))     }     keep <- head(keep, 5)     sub <- lapply(f2, function(ch) list(h1 = ch$h1[keep, , drop = FALSE], h2 = ch$h2[keep, , drop = FALSE]))     final <- self_plants(sub, n_f3, pos)     genotyped <- genotyped + length(keep) * n_f3     chosen <- hom_all(final, c("mA", "mB", "mC"))   }   true_pyramid <- hom_all(final, c("A", "B", "C"))   list(success = as.numeric(any(chosen & true_pyramid)),        cost = genotyped * cost_per_plant,        generations = if (strategy == "F2") 1 else 2,   # generations after the F1        plants = genotyped) } spec <- sim_function(   pyramid,   strategy = tune(), n_f2 = tune(), n_f3 = tune(),   link_cM = 20, marker_cM = 2, cost_per_plant = 6 )  metrics <- sim_metric_set(sim_metric("success", "maximize", label = "Chance of a pyramid"),                           cost, generations)
